q: What room temperature does the Level 3 manual specify for most air-conditioned rooms, including the operating room?
ref: DOH Manual on Technical Guidelines, 250-Bed Hospital (Level 3), 1st ed. 2017, Vol. 3, 250B-OR-RDS-04B
n: Standard design temperature is 23°C. Remember this: "+10 to protect, −10 to contain." Operating and delivery rooms push air OUT (+10 Pa) to keep germs away from the patient; isolation rooms pull air IN (−10 Pa) to keep germs away from everyone else. Most rooms: 23°C, 50% RH, 93–99% filtration at 1 micron. Word root: isolation = Latin insula "island".

q: What relative humidity does the manual specify for the operating room?
ref: DOH Manual on Technical Guidelines, 250-Bed Hospital (Level 3), 1st ed. 2017, Vol. 3, 250B-OR-RDS-04B
n: RH 50% with 93–99% dust filtration at 1 micron.

q: What pressure differential is specified for the operating room?
ref: DOH Manual on Technical Guidelines, 250-Bed Hospital (Level 3), 1st ed. 2017, Vol. 3, 250B-OR-RDS-04B
n: OR air flows outward to protect the surgical field.

q: What pressure differential is specified for the Emergency isolation room?
ref: DOH Manual on Technical Guidelines, 250-Bed Hospital (Level 3), 1st ed. 2017, Vol. 3, 250B-ER-RDS-06B
n: Isolation rooms (ER, ICU, dialysis) are negative 10 Pa.
